changes: Press Start now opens a random eligible game from your library while keeping its illustrated button and animation.
Replaced Random Game navigation with Game History, including a pixel journal icon, monthly grouping, play dates, player scores and personal notes.
Kept undated records in a separate section and used existing stable game IDs and saves without inventing dates, recording browsing as play activity or changing personal data.
Distinguished previous unpublished beta previews from published releases in the changelog.
Fixed Game History Back navigation after reopening the same section, and labeled status timestamps as activity rather than proof of a play session.
Fixed Play Next cards widening the page on narrow phones while retaining readable text and full covers.
Cleaned duplicate internal component IDs and made rebuilding the current page repeatable.
Prepared a clean publication file list that includes computed seasonal artwork and excludes authoring files, audit archives and obsolete artwork variants.
Fixed the Press Start blink so the drawn dark frame appears only after loading and the button stays readable if either image is unavailable.
